## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Project builds successfully
- [ ] Requested feature or fix works
- [ ] Host + Client tested when relevant
- [ ] Latency tested when relevant
- [ ] No unrelated code or asset changes

- [ ] GDD and V1 scope respected
- [ ] `DEVELOPMENT_STATUS.md` updated when appropriate
- [ ] Shared files/assets coordinated with the team
